group.label: Cache Warmer
group.comment: After a deploy (bin/magento zero:cache:warm --later) or Flush Magento Cache, the cron requests each store view's home page, categories, CMS pages, the paths below and its best-selling products once, one at a time, so the full page cache holds them before the first visitor. With Varnish the requests go to Varnish itself (the http_cache_hosts of env.php). Pages are warmed as a guest sees them.

field.label: Categories per Store View
field.comment: The top levels first. A category page not warmed is cached by its first visitor. 0: no category pages.

field.label: Products per Store View
field.comment: The best sellers of the last 90 days, then the newest products. 0: no product pages.

field.label: Also Warm
field.comment: Paths under each store view's URL, one a line (brands, blog). A path a store view doesn't have is skipped.

field.label: Warm a Page After It Is Saved
field.comment: A saved product (with its categories), category or CMS page is warmed again by the next cron run.

field.label: Wait While the Load Is Above
field.comment: The server's 1-minute load average; while it is higher the warmer waits, so visitors come first. 0: the number of CPU cores.
